requirement_text:
Organisation: Hindustan Consumer Products
Segment: Consumer Packaged Goods — Marketing Analytics

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
APP TYPE: Marketing Mix Modeling with Multi-Touch Attribution
SEGMENT: Consumer Packaged Goods — Marketing Analytics
PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: Hindustan Consumer Products allocates $240 million annually for marketing across 47 brands. The current effectiveness measurement through quarterly Nielsen studies, in-house models, and platform-reported ROAS lacks alignment. Insights are slow, and crucial questions regarding budget shifts cannot be confidently answered. A misallocation of 15-25% of spend is suspected but not provable without a robust analytics platform.
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Python, R, TensorFlow, PyMC3, Apache Kafka, Snowflake
INDEPENDENT VARIABLES: Weekly sales data by brand and geography; media spend and impression data by channel and campaign; promotional calendar and pricing data; competitor spend; weather; macroeconomic indicators; category-level trends
DEPENDENT VARIABLE: Sales, market share, Return on Investment (ROI)
ML ALGORITHM: Bayesian regression, Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)
EVALUATION METRICS: Improvement in Marketing ROI, accurac
